error.not_configured: Grafana URL or API token not set. Configure them in Settings → Plugins → Grafana Alerts.
error.unauthorized: Grafana rejected the token (401/403). Check the service account token and its role.
error.parse: Could not parse the Grafana response

grafana_url.label: Grafana URL
grafana_url.description: Base URL of your Grafana, e.g. https://grafana.example.com

api_token.label: API token
api_token.description: Service account token (Administration → Service accounts, role Viewer is enough).

ignore_datasource_alerts.label: Ignore datasource alerts
ignore_datasource_alerts.description: Hide the built-in DatasourceNoData / DatasourceError alerts.

hidden_labels.label: Hidden labels
hidden_labels.description: Labels not shown as tags in the panel (internal __ labels are always hidden).

hide_when_zero.label: Hide when empty
hide_when_zero.description: Hide the bar widget when no alert is firing.

critical_color.label: Critical color
critical_color.description: Color used for critical alerts (bar tint, badges).

filters.label: Filters
filters.description: Alertmanager matchers sent to the API, one per entry, e.g. team=infra or env!~"staging|dev".

severity_label.label: Severity label
severity_label.description: Name of the label carrying the severity (some setups use level or priority).

notify_new_alerts.label: Desktop notifications
notify_new_alerts.description: Send a notification (notify-send) when a new alert starts firing.

notify_min_severity.label: Notify from severity
notify_min_severity.description: Only notify for alerts at least this severe.

show_silence_button.label: Silence button
show_silence_button.description: Show the silence action on each alert (the token needs the Editor role).

silence_duration.label: Silence duration (minutes)
silence_duration.description: Length of the silences created from the panel.

silence.not_found: This alert is no longer in the list.
silence.forbidden: Grafana refused (401/403): creating silences needs the Editor role on the service account.
